# Retro Boomer security policy

## Project status

Retro Boomer is an independent fork of Parano1d. Release v1.0.0 is being prepared;
this document does not certify a production deployment or announce a published
release. The upstream Parano1d security team and bounty program do not cover
Retro Boomer by implication.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose unpatched vulnerabilities, private keys, mining API tokens,
wallet backups or other sensitive information in a public issue or pull request.

If private vulnerability reporting has been enabled by the repository owner,
use [the Retro Boomer security page](https://github.com/Aquacongas/retro-boomer/security)
and select **Report a vulnerability**. Its availability has not been confirmed.

Official Retro Boomer maintainer and support contact:
[aquacongass@proton.me](mailto:aquacongass@proton.me).
If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact the maintainer at
this address instead of disclosing sensitive details publicly. Never send
private keys, wallet backups or mining API tokens with a report.

A private report should identify the affected source revision or release,
platform, code path, impact and a minimal reproducer. Redact all credentials
and private wallet data. No bounty, payment, response deadline or upstream
support commitment is promised by this policy.

## Non-security bugs

Use [Retro Boomer issues](https://github.com/Aquacongas/retro-boomer/issues) for
non-sensitive, reproducible problems once the repository is populated.

## Upstream attribution

RETRO BOOMER derives from Parano1d. Original copyright and attribution information are retained in LICENSE, NOTICE and applicable source headers.
